spans.s:
--A son of Punarvasu and father of Devaka and Ugrasena and धृति (वा।);
1: भा. IX. २४. २०-21; वा. ९६. १२०-123; Vi. IV. १४. १५-16; Br. III. ७१. १२०-121.
a prince who had thousands of sons.
2: भा. I. १४. २८; X. ९०. ४२.
Hated by कंस.
3: Ib. X. ३६. २४ [२८]; X[५० (V) 8].
Consulted by कृष्ण on the eve of attack on जरासन्ध. His defence in the third campaign [page१-181+ ३४] of जरासन्ध.
4: Ib. X [५१ (V) २६].
Met कृष्ण at the council hall, and wel- comed him after the कुरुक्षेत्र war.
5: Ib. X. [६७ (V) ४२]; ८०. [१३].
Went to Syamanta- पञ्चक for solar eclipse.
6: Ib. X. ८२. 5.
An ideal ruler; married काशि king's daughter.
7: Br. III. ७१. १२८; M. ४४. ७०.
Specialist in chariot war;
8: वा. ९६. १२१-2; Br. III. ७१. १२२-3.
आहुकी was his sister, married to आहुकान्ध;
9: वा. ९६. १२७; M. ४४. ६६-70.
had ८०० lakhs of horses, २१,000 elephants with silver and gold chains in east and west directions; equal to great Bhoja;
१०: Br. III. ७१. १२३-127; वा. ९६. १२१-126; M. ४४. ६७-68.
informed of happenings in प्रभास.
११: Vi. V. ३७. ५९.
--the people of an eastern kingdom. Br. II. १६. ५२; वा. ४५. १२१.
--married sister of आहुक; father of two sons and a daughter. वा. ९६. १२७; Br. III. ७१. १२७.
--the daughter of Punarvasu and sister of आहुक (s.v.) the queen of the king of Avanti (आहुकान्ध)। भा. IX. २४. २१; Br. III. ७१. १२१ and १२७; M. ४४. ६६; वा. ९६. १२०, १२७; Vi. IV. १४. १५.
